title: The locked door
starting_code:
# Take the key first.
# Then open the door.
hints: The key lies on the floor. Walk up to it and take it.
Now walk to the door. You must stand right next to it.
Use the door's own action to open it.
intro: There is a locked door ahead. It needs its key. A good wizard does things in the right order.
outro: You opened the locked door. The top corridor waits.
learned: Now you know how to open a door with its key.
